correctness.rationale: Berger moment tilting fixes first and second moments. A degree-two Hermite interpolation remainder for t^(h+1)-lambda t^h has nonnegative quotient coefficients because a largest interpolation node dominates complete-homogeneous recurrences; opposite endpoint-root signs yield both exact ratio bounds. Positive reverse tilting realizes the extremizers at any observed index; convex interpolation fills the exact pointwise interval. Exact rational and LP checks corroborate but do not replace the proof.
